---
title: "check-pr-size.yml"
---

Diff-scoped, blocking check that fails a pull request changing more than 10 files or 300 lines.
Every PR should be as small and focused as it can be while completely solving its stated task.
A sweep goes out as minimal batches, one PR per batch of one concern.
This implements
[gha#1188](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/issues/1188).

The check counts the files a PR changes and the lines it adds plus deletes,
measured from the merge base to `HEAD`.
A rename counts as one file.
A binary file counts as one file and no lines.

These paths are not counted, since nobody writes them by hand:
lockfiles, `renv.lock`, `_freeze/`, `docs/`, images, PDFs, CSV and R data files, and minified scripts.
Add more with `paths-ignore`.

## Inputs

| Input | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `max-files` | `10` | Most files a PR may change |
| `max-lines` | `300` | Most added plus deleted lines |
| `paths-ignore` | none | Extra paths not counted (`*`, `?`, `**`) |
| `exempt-label` | `size-exempt` | Label that lifts the cap, read live through the API |
| `fail` | `true` | Block instead of warn |

## Scope

With no base to diff against, or when the diff cannot be computed,
the check skips with a warning instead of measuring the whole tree.
The caller stub triggers on `labeled` and `unlabeled`,
so adding the exemption label re-runs the check.

## Example

See [`examples/check-pr-size.yml`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/blob/main/examples/check-pr-size.yml).
